text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The night after the race, I spot Grass Wonder all by herself on the track.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, the shame… How could I let this happen?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The top is nothing but a distant dream if I can't even handle this much of a load.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I will need to work much, much harder if I am to live up to my own standards, let alone prevail over others…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's clearly at her wit's end. It might be a good idea to reconsider her schedule.
